draft.subject: Getting Orchard Ventures' first project started
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Thanks again for making time for the onboarding call last week. I know the start of a rollout is always the busiest part, so I wanted to check in.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time whenever you're ready to bring the team in.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
